6. Confirm the sealed corpus, blueprint, audit sample, historical closures, and unrelated G-ROUTE1/G-ROUTE3 material remain unchanged.

Round 1 may close only if all regenerated checks pass and the final independence re-check satisfies the frozen requirements. If any regenerated result introduces a new defect or fails a frozen condition, stop at that boundary rather than weakening or reinterpreting the criterion.
